row.name: Warner Bros. Discovery Inc. Series A Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=15 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.33 tightness=0.59 base_volume_vs_leg=0.92 base_volume_vs_avg=0.88
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average

notes: extension: close 8.2% vs its 20-SMA, 7.9% over 20 sessions

claude.reason: The burst bar is almost entirely an overnight gap (gap_pct 7.1% of the 10.79% gain, leaving only ~3.7% of intraday move), meaning the actionable range expansion happened in pre-market, not during the session — this is the hallmark of an Episodic Pivot or news-driven gap, not a clean momentum burst out of a base. The base itself (shaded box) shows multiple overlapping red and green bars with the price drifting lower through the consolidation period, giving it a mild downtrend character rather than a tight, flat coil. Combined with a 10.79% single-day gain that is near the 15% danger threshold and a base giveback of 0.33 (right at the A+ limit), the gap-dominated bar makes the entry plan structurally wrong — the stop at the burst-day low is now far below the open, and the move is largely spent before the open.
claude.key_risk: The majority of the gain was a pre-market gap, so buying at the open on day 1 means chasing a move that already happened, with a wide stop and little intraday edge.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the stock opens anywhere near or below the prior close (~27.80) or if it gaps further above 31 without a clean first-30-minute consolidation near the high.

row.summary: WBD: +10.8% on 5.3× volume out of a base 4.3% deep. C 10.0, 6 of 6 criteria.
